world.label: Cross-Border Bio-Surveillance Decision
world.summary: A partnership of four countries and a regional health network must decide by a deadline whether to activate a cross-border bio-surveillance early-warning system. Technical, legal, logistics, and community groups each raise a small, true concern local to their area through their own channel to a different member. Members meet regularly. mechanics.rationale: The group can mark that it raised a concern through its own channel. The model has no concern record, so this records the action in the group's work-cycle state without claiming to store the concern text or resolve it.

concern: A nonempty concern must be supplied.

checks.label: The concern must not be empty
This group must not have raised a concern in this work cycle
The group must raise concerns through its own local channel

limits: The concern text and its status are not represented; this records only that this group performed the move during the current work cycle.
tests: A local group with an unset work-cycle marker and nonempty concern can act and its marker becomes true.
An empty concern or a second attempt by the same group before the work-cycle reset is refused.
semantic_bindings: concern is the move's required text input

mechanics.rationale: The Technical Group can record that it performed a technical assessment. No technical evidence or assessment record is represented, so the effect does not assert that a risk was mitigated.

tests: The Technical Group can act with both text fields nonempty and an unset work-cycle marker.

semantic_bindings: concern and findings_or_mitigation are required move inputs

mechanics.rationale: A partnership member can record a considered outcome or next step after its own recorded reopening request. The issue's status and the outcome are not represented, so the move does not claim resolution.

tests: A partnership member who has requested reopening can reconsider with nonempty text fields.

mechanics.rationale: A partnership member can record that it made its support conditional for the represented activation question. The model has no support or condition record, so the effect records only that the member performed the move; it does not alter partnership support.

condition: A nonempty condition must be supplied.

checks.label: The condition must not be empty
The activation question must be the decision
The activation question must have a deadline
This member must not have made support conditional in this work cycle
The member must belong to the partnership

limits: Neither member support nor the stated condition has a represented state path; this records only the member's action and cannot enact or verify conditional support.
tests: A partnership member can perform the move for the activation question with a nonempty condition and an unset work-cycle marker.
A different decision, missing deadline, nonmember, empty condition, or repeated same-cycle attempt is refused.
semantic_bindings: decision identifies the represented activation question

mechanics.rationale: A partnership member can record a restoration move for the represented activation question after its own conditional-support move. Because no condition, remedy, or support state is represented, the move cannot verify that a condition was met or enact restored support.

checks.label: The activation question must be the decision
This member must have made support conditional in this work cycle
This member must not have performed a restoration move in this work cycle
The member must belong to the partnership

limits: The member's support, stated condition, and evidence that the condition was met are not represented; this records only the restoration move and does not enact unconditional support.
tests: A partnership member who recorded conditional support in this work cycle can record restoration for the activation question.
A different decision, member without a same-cycle conditional-support marker, nonmember, or repeated same-cycle restoration is refused.
semantic_bindings: decision identifies the represented activation question
